notes: Left the 13 stale docs/guidelines/AI_*.md pages unrewritten: they are the repository's mandatory policy documents (AGENTS.md says to read them), they describe process rather than library code, and nothing in this feature changes what they say. They are flagged stale only because the files they cover changed. Rewriting policy text without a request risks altering policy, so please confirm if a rewrite is wanted.
